title: Design System: Simulador de Lupa CVDentus

display.purpose: Hero video card title only — the one Display-scale moment in the system.

headline.purpose: Section titles below the hero, e.g. "Vantagens de usar a lupa."

title.purpose: Short confident labels: model chip names, advantage-item titles.

body.purpose: All supporting/paragraph copy across cards and footer.

micro.purpose: The smallest tags/hints: model tags, 3D viewer tag and hint chips.

shadows.name: shadow-ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Tight contact shadow paired with shadow-ambient-md on every resting card/chip.

shadows.name: shadow-ambient-md
shadows.purpose: Wide, soft ambient spread — the system's default resting elevation for cards.

shadows.name: shadow-chip-hover
shadows.purpose: Model chip / footer link hover state, paired with a 2px lift.

shadows.name: shadow-accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Signal Blue buttons only — a color-tinted glow instead of neutral gray, reinforcing the accent.

shadows.name: shadow-catalog-glow
shadows.purpose: Stronger accent glow for the footer catalog CTA.

shadows.name: shadow-hero-dark
shadows.purpose: White CTA pill sitting on the dark hero video card.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/press on buttons, chips, and toggles (color, background, box-shadow, transform).

motion.name: ease-toast
motion.purpose: Calibration toast fade/slide in and out.

motion.name: active-press-scale
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on every button variant.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Hover lift on cards, model chips, and footer link pills, paired with a deeper shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Blue filled pill with a tinted glow shadow — the system's one high-commitment action (e.g. the footer catalog link).

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #2f5fc4; color: #fff; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(47,95,196,.28); transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5fc4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero CTA Button
components.description: White pill with near-black text — the inverse button reserved for sitting on the dark hero video card.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; color: #14161c; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 0.2px; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-hero:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: White pill, no border, separation from shadow alone — secondary actions like "Pausar giro"/"Vista inicial."
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.2px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1c2130; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.03), 0 6px 16px rgba(16,24,40,.06); transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #2f5fc4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.03), 0 8px 20px rgba(47,95,196,.14); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5fc4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Model Chip
components.description: Selectable product chip in the model picker — white at rest, Signal-Blue-Soft with a blue border when active. Holds a thumbnail, title-weight name, and an uppercase label-weight tag.
components.css: .ds-model-chip { background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; color: #1c2130; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.03), 0 6px 18px rgba(16,24,40,.05); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; min-width: 130px; } .ds-model-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.03), 0 10px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.08); } .ds-model-chip--active { border-color: #2f5fc4; background: #eaf1fc; } .ds-model-chip__name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.1px; } .ds-model-chip__tag { font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.7px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5266; }

components.css: .ds-hero-card { position: relative; text-align: center; border-radius: 40px; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: #14161c; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 32px 26px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.03), 0 14px 34px rgba(16,24,40,.07); font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-hero-card__media { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; } .ds-hero-card__media video { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-hero-card__scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,12,20,.30) 0%, rgba(8,10,18,.62) 100%); } .ds-hero-card__content { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-hero-card__title { font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(26px,6.5vw,36px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.3px; margin: 0 0 10px; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-hero-card__sub { font-weight: 400; font-size: 14.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.88); line-height: 1.55; max-width: 360px; margin: 0 auto 26px; letter-spacing: 0.1px; text-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

narrative.overview:
This is a clinical tool wearing a calm, confident, technical face — not a marketing showcase. The interface gets out of the way of two things: the visitor's own live camera feed, and the six real loupe products it renders on top of it. Everything not directly in service of that (page chrome, supporting copy, secondary actions) is deliberately quiet: flat white cards on a barely-there gray canvas, one accent color spent with visible restraint, generous whitespace, and type that leans light rather than loud. The one place the system allows itself real drama is the hero — a looping product video with a dark scrim and white display type — because that's the single moment the product is allowed to perform before the tool-like interface takes over.

This system was arrived at, not assumed: an earlier glassmorphism pass (frosted panels over a blurred photo) was built, tested, and explicitly rejected as too busy and low-contrast for a tool meant to be read quickly, often on a phone, often mid-sales-conversation. The generic "sunglasses brand" aesthetic — bold color blocking, loud gradients — was rejected for the same reason: this is optical/dental equipment, not eyewear fashion.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white cards, zero borders, one soft diffuse shadow vocabulary — depth by shadow, never by glass or gradient panels.
A single accent color (Signal Blue) reserved for selection state, primary actions, and small functional accents — never used for large fills.
Solid dark chips (near-black or blue-tinted, white text) exclusively where content sits over live camera, video, or 3D render — the one place the system trades "quiet" for "legible no matter what."
Montserrat at every weight from 300 to 800 is the only typeface in the system; hierarchy comes from weight and letter-spacing, not from mixing families.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears in small, functional doses only — a border, an icon chip, a button fill, a slider thumb. It never becomes a large background surface; that would break the "quiet instrument" premise.

rules.name: The Solid-Chip Exception
rules.body: Any text or control that sits directly on top of live camera video, the looping hero video, or the 3D canvas gets a solid dark chip (near-black or blue-tinted rgba over near-black) with white text — never a translucent/glass treatment — because the content underneath is unpredictable and legibility cannot be negotiable there.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second typeface for emphasis or hierarchy; reach for a heavier or lighter Montserrat weight and adjusted letter-spacing instead.

rules.name: The Ambient-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, wide, and low-opacity at rest everywhere except the dark hero/camera/3D surfaces. A harder or tinted shadow is a deliberate signal (hover state, accent action), never a resting default.

dos: Do spend Signal Blue only on small, functional elements (borders, icon fills, button fills, thumbs) — never as a large background.
Do use a solid dark chip with white text for anything overlaid on live camera, video, or 3D canvas content.
Do keep every card and pill border-free, relying on the ambient shadow vocabulary for separation.
Do use flexbox with justify-content: center (not CSS Grid auto-fit) for any wrapping row of chips/cards, so an incomplete last row centers as a group.
Do carry hierarchy through Montserrat weight and letter-spacing, not additional typefaces.
Do render each social/platform logo in the footer in that platform's own official brand colors, not the system palette — an intentional, scoped exception to the color tokens above.
donts: Don't reintroduce glassmorphism/translucent-over-photo panels — tested this session and rejected for busyness and poor contrast on a tool meant to be read quickly.
Don't use a generic eyewear/sunglasses-brand visual language (bold color blocking, loud gradients) — this is dental/optical equipment, not fashion eyewear.
Don't give any card or button a visible stroke border at rest; separation comes from shadow.
Don't let the Display-scale hero typography or the video/scrim treatment leak into the functional cards below the hero — that expressive register is reserved for the hero moment only.
